_comment: 美学 token v2（2026-08-31 原生 PPTX 改版）：每个主题双轨——native=python-pptx 渲染 token（色板/字体/字号锚），prompt_tokens=AI 插图槽位仍走 gptimage2。html 主题美学继承不变。

paper-ink.name: 纸墨
paper-ink.prompt_tokens: warm beige paper background, minimal flat illustration style, deep ink-black text, cinnabar red accent highlights, generous whitespace, East Asian editorial aesthetic, clean geometric shapes, no gradients
paper-ink.mood: 安静的图书馆，不是科技发布会

mo-xian.name: 墨线
mo-xian.prompt_tokens: dark charcoal background with electric blue accent lines, high contrast infographic style, clean skeleton structure, data visualization aesthetic, information-dense but orderly, neon-blue highlights on dark ground

kan-shi.name: 刊式
kan-shi.prompt_tokens: ivory magazine cover aesthetic, bold black editorial headlines, warm cream background, clean typography-forward composition, premium print journalism feel, strong visual hierarchy, minimal decoration
kan-shi.mood: 高端杂志封面，观点型短文气质

guang-shu.name: 光栅
guang-shu.prompt_tokens: bright white background with blue left-border chapter dividers, orange bullet accents, modern clean layout, approachable tech-blog aesthetic, balanced information density, friendly color palette

night-desk.name: 夜案
night-desk.prompt_tokens: dim warm desk lamp atmosphere, deep brownish-black background, amber accent anchors, nighttime coding session mood, low-luminance technical notes aesthetic, subtle texture, comfortable for long reading
night-desk.mood: 深夜书桌，琥珀锚点的宁静技术空间

fallback_theme.name: neutral-minimal
fallback_theme.prompt_tokens: clean minimalist slide design, lots of whitespace, subtle accent color, flat illustration style, professional presentation aesthetic, simple geometric accents

typography_scale._comment: 吸收 ppt-master 字号角色比例（相对 body 锚点）。body 锚点按画布：16:9/4:3=18pt，3:4=16pt。

cover.description: 封面：大标题+副题+主题色装饰条

section.description: 章节页：大号章节号+标题，留白

bullets.description: 要点页：标题+左对齐要点列表

two-column.description: 双栏页：标题+左右两组要点

quote.description: 引用页：大号引文+出处，大量留白

hero-number.description: 数字页：单个大数字/结论+一行说明

image-right.description: 图文页：左文右图（图槽可 AI 生成或占位）

closing.description: 封底：核心结论回显+行动号召
